name: Sri Subhananda Devi Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Goddess Parvati, divine consort of Mukteshwara Swamy. Available services include Kumkuma Archana (₹50), Odi Biyam / Suhasini Puja (₹100), and Chandi Homam / Special Puja (₹500).

name: Sri Maha Saraswati Devi Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Goddess Maha Saraswati. Available services include Aksharabhyasam / Saraswati Archana (₹100) and Vidyarambha Puja (₹150).

name: Sri Adi Mukteshwara Swamy Shrine
significance: Shrine dedicated to Lord Adi Mukteshwara. Available services include Adi Mukteshwara Abhishekam (₹100).

name: Sri Suryanarayana Swamy Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to the Sun God. Available services include Surya Namaskaram & Archana (₹50).

name: Sri Dattatreya Swamy Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Lord Dattatreya Swamy.

name: Sri Sangameshwara Swamy Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Lord Sangameshwara Swamy.

name: Sri Rama Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Lord Sri Rama.

name: Sri Panchamukhi Anjaneya Swamy Temple
significance: Shrine dedicated to Lord Panchamukhi Anjaneya Swamy.

name: Ganapeshwaralayam (Kota Gullu)
significance: Historical temple shrine in the complex.
